meta.title: Firefly III bookkeeping
meta.description: Record, query, correct and delete Firefly III transactions from chat, and maintain the accounts, categories, budgets and tags they depend on. Nine domain tools cover transactions, master data, reports, subscriptions/recurrences/piggy banks, attachments, rules/currencies/webhooks and CSV exports. Reads live metadata before every write, refuses to guess ids when autoCreate is off, and requires approval for deletions, bulk moves, budget-limit changes, rule/webhook triggers and currency changes. Purge and destroy endpoints are permanently blocked. The Settings → Firefly III page sets the instance URL and personal access token (the token is written to the local credential store only), flips the five autoCreate switches, tests the connection, and saves through the config editor into the local profile; /firefly-token and /firefly-status remain available. Attachments stay inside the session workspace and obey maxAttachmentMb. Transaction data is sent only to the configured Firefly III instance. When the session approval policy is Never, destructive actions are refused; switch it to Ask to use them.
